original_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.213'}) MATCH (cr)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) MATCH (cr)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(co:Company) RETURN cr.tdocNumber, cr.title, co.companyName, m.meetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, cr.tdocNumber LIMIT 20
question_en: List the 20 most recent CRs modifying TS 38.213 (recent changes).
reference_query:
MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.213'})
MATCH (cr)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting)
WITH cr, max(m.sourceReportedEndDate) AS meetingPeriodEndDate
RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, meetingPeriodEndDate
ORDER BY meetingPeriodEndDate DESC, tdocNumber ASC
